baseline.method: original author simplified homogeneous halfspace tied-deep conditional NNLS, not geologic truth

reference_kind: conditional validated original method result, not truth
nrmse_definition: RMS error divided by reference dynamic range over all1292main fault patches. Constant/nonfinite references are evaluator errors. Other required quantities use separate max-absolute errors in declared physical units.
observation_metric_definition: sqrt((d-Gm)^T Cd^-1(d-Gm)/3554), using independently captured original geometry-derived operator and known noise covariance.
tolerance_provenance: Frozen before local extraction from independent original rerun and float32-serialization diagnostic, factor1.5; see test/fixtures/prefrozen_criteria.json and validation.md.
